**F013-i0 medium/correctness finding (role model suppressed when a roles entry names a profile):** Addressed red/green. I first reproduced the auditor's exact failure (`roles.auditor={name: honey, model: gpt-role}` with a model-less `honey` profile on the codex harness → `resolve_model(..., harness="codex")` returned `None`), then added failing regression tests, then fixed `config/resolvers.py`. The fix adds `_dispatch_harness_for(name, project_path)`, which maps the expected role value through D015 alias normalization and the merged global→project worker-profile table (identity only — no role/capability gates) to the `AGENT_REGISTRY` key it actually dispatches as; `resolve_model` now compares that resolved harness, not the raw configured string, against the dispatched harness. Unknown names still fail closed (model suppressed), and the import stays one-way via a lazy import mirroring `worker_profiles`' existing lazy import of resolvers. Five regression tests were added to `test_f013_worker_profiles.py`: the auditor's recommended case (profile id + canonical `roles.auditor.model` → model applies), per-call dispatch to a different harness still suppressed, a D015 alias in the roles entry now counted as its registry key (a second latent bug the s
